# My Skill Collection

A personal library of [Agent Skills](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills/overview) for Claude (claude.ai, Claude Code and the Agent SDK), organized by area. Every skill is reviewed for prompt injection and unsafe instructions before it is added. See [docs/security-review.md](docs/security-review.md).

## Layout

```
skills/
  design/          UI/UX, component libraries, visual design
  media/           video, film, animation, audio production
  engineering/     coding workflows, reviews, testing, infra
  data/            analysis, SQL, notebooks, visualization
  writing/         docs, reports, communication styles
  productivity/    planning, meetings, personal workflows
  research/        research methods, literature, market analysis
templates/skill-template/   starting point for a new skill
scripts/                    validate, catalog and package tooling
docs/                       authoring guide + security review checklist
.claude-plugin/             makes this repo installable as a Claude Code plugin marketplace
```

Each skill is a folder: `skills/<area>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` (+ optional `references/`, `scripts/`, `assets/`, `LICENSES/`, `PROVENANCE.md`). The folder name must equal the `name:` in the frontmatter.

## Using the skills

**Claude Code: plugin marketplace (recommended)**
```
/plugin marketplace add jaskaran1991singh/My_skill_collection
/plugin install design-skills@my-skill-collection
```
Each area is its own plugin (`design-skills`, `engineering-skills`, …), so you install only the areas you need.

**Claude Code: copy one skill**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/jaskaran1991singh/My_skill_collection
cp -r My_skill_collection/skills/design/ui-library-design ~/.claude/skills/      # all projects
# or: cp -r … <project>/.claude/skills/                                           # one project
```

**claude.ai / Claude app:** run `scripts/package_skill.sh skills/design/ui-library-design`, then upload the zip in **Settings → Capabilities → Skills**.

## Adding a skill

1. `cp -r templates/skill-template skills/<area>/<new-skill-name>`
2. Edit `SKILL.md`: set `name`, write a specific `description` (what it does and when to use it), and keep the body under ~500 lines. Move detail into `references/`.
3. If it comes from a third party, follow [docs/security-review.md](docs/security-review.md) and add a `PROVENANCE.md`.
4. `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py && python3 scripts/build_catalog.py`
5. Commit. CI runs the same validation on every push and PR.

To add a new **area**, create `skills/<area>/` and run `build_catalog.py`. That script also regenerates `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.
